sm_co2.license_note: public domain (NOAA/Scripps via statsmodels, package BSD-3-Clause)
sm_co2.missingness_policy: forward-fill declared at load; raw NaN count recorded

sm_nile.license_note: public domain (classic Nile series via statsmodels)

excluded_classes.financial: order T2.0.3: financial data may never replace missing public tasks (FX/equity/VIX inventories under feature-eng/tests/data and examples/data are excluded)
excluded_classes.synthetic_own: order T2.0.3: synthetic replicas may never replace missing public tasks (synthetic-datagen outputs, T1 bank units)
excluded_classes.macro_economic: statsmodels macrodata is economic — excluded under the non-financial rule

deficit.reason: the preferred confirmatory sources are absent from local storage and network retrieval is outside standing constraints; the local development units are univariate, short and span only 3 independent families — insufficient task support for the sealed confirmatory gate (whole-family holdouts + multiplicity correction)
